note: worker-4 /dev/sda of the OKD lab cluster on 2026-09-30: a device a previous simplyblock deployment took, whose ALCEML_STORAGE superblock at offset 0 has been zeroed while the rest of the device was left. Only the first 4096 bytes are zero; the mapping region starts at 4096 and runs to the end of the head, and the page grid at 1060864 carries _UNMAPPED_ headers repeating every 2105344 bytes, so the data pages were never written. Unlike the alceml-pages capture, whose whole 1060864-byte head was zero and which therefore reads Blank, this one reads Foreign at any region size and discovery declined it: the fleet came up with worker-4 contributing one 1.5 TB disk where every other worker contributed two.
